task: Controlled 5-query live Naukri validation: UA configuration reliability + empirical jobAge=3 native freshness filter confirmation
scope_limit: exactly five queries; no other job boards, Excel generation, application automation, or scheduler work performed in this task

execution_method.batching: one search_run containing all 5 query entries, processed in one process_queue_item() call -- discover_from_sources() runs one health_check() then adapter.search() once per query, in order, unmodified
observation_wrappers_runtime_only_no_fil: naukri_adapter.classify_search_page (pass-through, records classification per call, in order)
naukri_adapter.NaukriAdapter.search (pass-through, records query/timing/raw_count/error per call, in order)
execution_method.temp_db_creation_method: shutil.copy2 of data/applications/jobos.db to a new temp file (read-only access to production)

per_query_results_facts_observed.redirect_note: Naukri's own server-side metro-area URL normalization (hyderabad -> hyderabad-secunderabad); classifier still reached VALID_RESULTS on the redirected page; existing, unmodified redirect-following behavior, no code change made

malformed_job_note.detail: Job #3 (index 3 of the combined 100 raw jobs) was missing the required 'company' field and was skipped by discover_local.normalize_job()
malformed_job_note.classification: existing, documented fallback behavior ("one malformed job is skipped, not fatal"), NOT a new defect introduced by this task or the prior UA change

jobage_3_empirical_validation.previously: only URL/UI verified -- jobAge=3 parameter construction was confirmed present in the outgoing request, but no successful returned listings had ever been analyzed for it (every prior attempt was blocked pre-UA-fix)

discovery_time_vs_post_retrieval_freshne.discovery_time: the ?jobAge=3 URL parameter sent to Naukri's own server -- this is what actually reduces the number of jobs Naukri returns
discovery_time_vs_post_retrieval_freshne.post_retrieval: freshness.py's independent classify_freshness() parsing each job's own posted_date text after the fact, unaware of which URL parameter fetched the page
discovery_time_vs_post_retrieval_freshne.relationship: the post-retrieval classification's results (all <= 3 days) corroborate that the discovery-time filter worked, rather than being the mechanism that enforced it

jobage_3_empirical_validation.remaining_uncertainty_interpretation: one successful 5-query trial does not prove Naukri's jobAge=3 filter behaves identically for every role/location combination, at every time of day, or indefinitely into the future -- only that it worked, verifiably, for these five location queries at this run

scored_jobs_this_run.title: AWS Cloud Infra and DevOps Engineer
Staff Software Engineer - Platform and Infrastructure
Senior / Lead Azure Cloud & Infrastructure Architect

production_pipeline_authoritative_dedup.basis: post-normalization, the number that actually governs what lands in the DB

this_validations_own_raw_pre_normalizati.basis: observational only, computed from the 5 per-query raw job-URL lists before normalization/dedup ran
this_validations_own_raw_pre_normalizati.interpretation: the overwhelming majority of cross-query duplicates are the Bangalore/Bengaluru spelling-variant pair for the same city -- confirms production dedup is correctly collapsing the same real-world job posted under two different location-query slugs into one canonical entry

cross_query_duplicate_analysis.note_on_the_two_different_numbers: 27 (post-normalization, of 99) vs 23 (raw, pre-normalization, of 100 including the 1 malformed job that never reached dedup) are not expected to match exactly -- both are consistent with each other and with a real, working cross-query dedup step

production_db_after.write_target_for_this_run: temporary DB copy only, deleted after validation

regression_suite.reason_no_new_tests: this was a live validation task, not an implementation task

basis: single-query live validation (prior task): 1/1 query succeeded
this controlled 5-query live validation: 5/5 queries succeeded, 0 blocks, 0 retries
jobAge=3 empirically confirmed by returned listings, not just URL/UI inspection
naukri_phase_1_validated.remaining_limitation_interpretation: 6 total successful live queries across 2 sessions is evidence of reliability, not a guarantee of indefinite reliability -- Naukri's server-side behavior could change at any time, independent of anything in this codebase. Validated here means validated against the evidence gathered so far, not provably permanent.

recommended_next_gate: Phase 4: multi-source adapter architecture (LinkedIn, Indeed, Foundit, Instahyre, Wellfound, career pages), offline-only until each adapter independently passes its own Phase-1/Phase-2/Phase-3 gates exactly as Naukri just did. Naukri daily-scale validation (a later Naukri-specific gate) remains available but was not authorized or started in this task.
